description: Item-by-item reading of the 8 SVAMP items (of 948 checked) where the system's (paper-eval-v2) trusted value disagreed with the gold answer, from eval/results/system_runs_v2/svamp.jsonl. Each item is classed as a verifier error or a benchmark-label issue, with the baseline's outcome on the same item.

Cookies baked till last night: 31 yesterday + 419 the day before = 450. The verifier also adds the 270 baked this morning (720), and the reply follows it. The one item the verifier cost the system against the baseline.
